## Learning Objectives {.objectives}

-   Write a 90-day plan with three concrete priorities.
-   Know what to read next.

## Planning at the Right Timescale

-   Ninety days is long enough to finish something and short enough to be concrete.
-   Three kinds of work must appear in the plan.
-   Development of new features.
-   Maintenance: bug fixes, reviews, dependency updates, and compliance.
-   Getting support for future work: impact summaries and grant proposals.
-   Maintenance consumes all time if not explicitly allocated.

## The Monday Morning Test

-   A plan with five priorities cannot be finished in ninety days.
-   Write a plan with three priorities, each with a clear definition of done.
-   Ask "what is the first thing you will do on Monday morning?"
-   If you cannot answer, the goal is too vague.
-   "Work on the documentation" is not well defined; a specific first step is.
